title: LinkedProjectToDbChannelProjectLink
description: What process-summary sends to the DynamoDB channel_project_link table about a channel's linked project. It first reads the link with a consistent GetItem on the key channel_id alone; if the channel has one, it then records when the summary arrived with a conditional UpdateItem that sets only last_summary_at, so project_id is never overwritten.

channel_id.description: The table's key: the Slack channel.

last_summary_at.description: ISO 8601 time in UTC when a summary was last received; sent only by the update.
